about: Static 3D props made with Meshy (text to 3D), voxelised into box models by tools/meshy/voxelize.py. history labels the object, as in content/sites.json: VERIFIED (a known kind of object), INSPIRED (a reconstruction from written sources). Each prop is a simplified game version, never a copy of a particular monument.

props.name: Хархорумын Чулуун Мэлхий
props.prompt: ancient carved grey granite turtle statue, Mongol Empire Karakorum style, a large stone tortoise with a rectangular socket on its back, weathered stone surface, sitting flat on the ground, one solid object, no base plate
props.texture: weathered grey granite, lichen spots, carved shell plates, no paint

props.name: Мөнгөн Мод
props.prompt: the silver tree fountain of the Mongol palace at Karakorum: a large silver tree with silver branches and leaves, gilded serpents coiling down the trunk, a winged figure blowing a trumpet on top, four silver lions around the base, ornate metalwork, one solid object
props.texture: polished silver tree and lions, gold serpents, aged metal, no plastic

props.name: Буган Хөшөө
props.prompt: bronze age Mongolian deer stone, a tall rectangular granite stele carved with stylized flying deer with long antlers, a ring band near the top, belt and dagger carvings near the bottom, weathered, standing upright, one solid object
props.texture: grey granite with shallow carved deer, weathered, orange lichen

props.name: Хүн Чулуу
props.prompt: Turkic era stone statue from the Mongolian steppe: a standing man carved from one granite pillar, round flat face with a thin moustache, both hands holding a cup in front of his chest, a belt with a small hanging pouch, simple robe, weathered stone, no beard, no hat, no chinese style, one solid object
props.texture: weathered grey granite, simple carved face and belt, orange lichen spots, no paint

rejected.why: Meshy kept making a cloth banner (once with a sun-like emblem), not the horsehair tug; not shipped
